description: This Java class 'UserService' provides user management functionalities for a book tracking application, including registration, authentication, password management, account locking, and user data retrieval.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service class managing user registration, authentication, password policies, account locking, and user data operations within the book tracking application.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user after validation and checks for existing email, then authenticates the user.

methods.name: createNewUser
methods.description: Creates a new User entity with default role and encoded password.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the currently authenticated user from security context.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns all users (test data population).

methods.name: findUserById
methods.description: Finds a user by their ID.

methods.name: findUserByEmail
methods.description: Finds a user by their email.

methods.name: authenticateUser
methods.description: Performs authentication for a user and sets security context.

methods.name: isEmailInUse
methods.description: Checks if an email is already registered.

methods.name: changeUserEmail
methods.description: Changes user's email after password verification and validation.

methods.name: isPasswordStrengthVeryStrong
methods.description: Checks if a password has very strong strength using ZXCVBN.

methods.name: isPasswordTooWeak
methods.description: Determines if a password is too weak based on strength criteria.

methods.name: changeUserPassword
methods.description: Updates user's password after strength validation and encoding.

methods.name: deleteUserById
methods.description: Deletes a user by ID, removing associated predefined shelves and books.

methods.name: passwordIsIncorrect
methods.description: Checks if provided password does not match current user's password.

methods.name: removePredefinedShelfFromUserBooks
methods.description: Removes predefined shelf associations from user's books.

methods.name: increaseFailAttempts
methods.description: Increments failed login attempts for a user.

methods.name: resetFailAttempts
methods.description: Resets failed login attempts for a user.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks a user account and records lock time.

methods.name: hoursUntilUnlock
methods.description: Calculates hours remaining until account unlock.

methods.name: unlockWhenTimeExpired
methods.description: Unlocks user account if lock duration has expired.
